title: Computational modeling of crack-tip fields in transversely isotropic strain-limiting solids subjected to piecewise linear slope loads
summary: Crack-tip fields within a transversely isotropic strain-limiting elastic body are investigated under the influence of piecewise linear slope boundary loads. The mechanical response is characterized via a nonlinear constitutive framework relating the Cauchy stress to the linearized strain, by which non-physical strain singularities at the crack tip are eliminated. The governing system is formulated as a quasi-linear elliptic boundary value problem in terms of the displacement field and is solved utilizing a continuous Galerkin finite element method coupled with a Picard linearization scheme.…
